name: Debashish Deb
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer & Biotechnologist
tagline: Full-Stack Software Engineer & IT Specialist at Färkkilä Lab, University of Helsinki. Architecting scalable software and scientific digital infrastructure.
about: I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer and IT & Systems Specialist at Färkkilä Laboratory (University of Helsinki). With an M.Sc. in Molecular Biotechnology and deep software engineering expertise, I bridge full-stack software development, distributed algorithms, and biomedical research computing.
aboutExtended:
At the University of Helsinki's renowned Färkkilä Laboratory (Biomedicum Helsinki), I coordinate CSC scientific supercomputing services, lab web architecture, and research databases for precision oncology (ONCOSYS-OVA) and spatial multi-omics.

My background in molecular biotechnology, combined with over a decade of operational and engineering experience in Finland and co-authored cancer oncology publications in Haematologica and Blood, drives my commitment to delivering software with scientific rigor, high availability, and flawless execution.
status: Full-Stack Engineer • IT Specialist @ Färkkilä Lab (UH)

projects.name: Riverlines
projects.description: A Video.js skin for documentary archives. Watch three views of Dhaka’s Buriganga River with Bangla and English captions and a transcript that jumps to the spoken line.
highlights: The active transcript line and dated filmstrip follow the same playback clock.
Keyboard and touch controls, dual-language captions, and a local playback fallback.

projects.name: Workspace OS — Operations Platform
projects.description: A modular, scalable operational platform engineered for digital agencies, service firms, and distributed offshore teams. Features unified client workspaces, milestone dashboards, automated invoice tracking, and secure role-based access control.
highlights: Modular workspace engine allowing teams to activate custom operational tools
Real-time milestone tracking, task boards, and automated delivery records
Zero-trust authentication and enterprise role-based authorization hierarchy

projects.name: Jutera — Sustainable Living Platform
projects.description: Curated digital platform and interactive showcase for handcrafted sustainable jute living objects and European retail/wholesale distribution. Built with React, Three.js 3D model visualization, Tailwind CSS, Vite, and high-performance PWA caching.
highlights: Integrated interactive Three.js 3D brand logo rendering in real-time WebGL
Sub-second page loads with modern WebP asset compression and PWA caching
Full Schema.org structured data and open graph metadata architecture

projects.name: BioScan / Mobile Document OCR
projects.description: Privacy-first Android utility app engineered in Flutter. Features on-device ML Kit barcode & QR code recognition, zero-account architecture, bilingual Bangla/English interface, Tesseract OCR document extraction, and local SQLite history with zero third-party tracking.
highlights: 100% on-device ML inference with zero telemetry or network data leakage
Sub-100ms real-time barcode scanning with auto-focus and low-light flashlight toggle
Bilingual localization (Bangla & English) and offline SQLite scan history export

projects.name: BDNewsReader
projects.description: Bilingual news aggregation and reader platform built with Flutter, Riverpod, and a self-hosted Fastify backend. Features native article formatting, offline caching via Drift/SQLite, official YouTube Live TV streaming (IFrame integration), and bilingual Bangla/English text-to-speech audio narration.
highlights: Self-hosted Fastify backend scraping and caching verified news streams
Bilingual text-to-speech audio engine for automated article playback
Offline-first Drift ORM persistence with background periodic syncing

projects.name: Färkkilä Lab Infrastructure & Systems
projects.description: Coordinating Finnish CSC scientific computing services, relational research databases, and public web platforms for precision oncology and spatial multi-omics at Biomedicum Helsinki.
highlights: High-performance computing coordination for spatial multi-omics pipelines
Clinical registry and patient specimen tracking database architecture
Web platform development and high-availability scientific data portals

projects.name: Stations-Pathfinder
projects.description: Graph routing engine written in Golang that calculates optimal collision-free paths for concurrent trains moving across dynamic railway track topologies with turn-based orchestration.
highlights: Concurrent turn-based simulation with dynamic collision avoidance
Algorithmic graph traversal finding Pareto-optimal transit solutions
Strict Go memory constraints and high-throughput benchmark tests

projects.name: Art-Interface
projects.description: Interactive web application and decoding engine in Golang enabling users to transform, parse, and render ASCII art through an intuitive browser interface.
highlights: Custom ASCII font parser and rasterizer written in Go standard library
Real-time client-side preview with responsive export options
Zero-dependency lightweight binary deployment
